scope: Nonstellar error provenance for pinned H0DN V01; no means, fit or upstream execution

blocks.source_kind: Published upstream per-row errors plus configurable independent intrinsic variance; no full calibrator covariance supplied to this function.
Published upstream per-row errors; upstream quadrature omits the -2 Cov(m110,M110) term and cross-host covariance.

blocks.offdiagonal_upstream: zero; shared group distance parameter resides in design, not a second error covariance
blocks.source_kind: Input group-depth/scatter constraint; not a measured matrix of all host distances.

blocks.covariance_input: Pinned sn1a_covar_pp.dat, 277x277, mag^2, original row order
blocks.covariance_in_intercept_units: V_SN=C_mag/25 + diag(velocity_variance), restricted by same row selection if any
notes: No active redshift cut in V01: all 277 rows retained.
Covariance path supersedes mb_err in compute_alpha; mb_err is not added again.
Optional intrinsic increment in mb_err does not alter the supplied covariance path; current configured extra intrinsic is zero.
Upstream uses ordinary inverse, not the qualified support guard; later assembly must verify support and avoid a silent inverse-to-pseudoinverse replacement.
zhel enters the mean transformation, not this implemented error propagation; it was not extracted.

blocks.unused_available_error: e(M110): nonzero in all 61 flow rows; available does not establish that it should be added independently or is already absorbed.
blocks.source_kind: Upstream inverse-variance compression with independent flow errors; no supplied SBF covariance used by the call.

blocks.unconverted_required_input: D, zero-based column 1 in megamaser.dat; available in source but outside this extraction authorization.
notes: Upstream symmetrizes asymmetric distance errors and uses first-order log propagation.
The velocity error ignores the derivative of G(z), and q0/j0 uncertainties are not propagated; these are upstream approximations, not an exact total physical covariance.

cross_block_covariances.upstream: zero for the nonstellar blocks and their links to the stellar error block; shared latent parameters belong to the design
cross_block_covariances.statute: INPUT/modeling choice, not an experimentally measured independence claim
cross_block_covariances.no_duplicate_observations: Do not add aggregate H0 or the individual flow rows as independent observations when already using their compressed intercept.
cross_block_covariances.finite_scope: Specific potential shared calibration/flow-systematic components may be tested by an explicit finite nuisance/PSD sensitivity model. No demand for every conceivable covariance.

q0_j0.implemented_errors: No dependence on q0/j0 in the selected conditional error formulas. SN and MM means vary; SBF explicitly ignores cosmology.
q0_j0.if_uncertain: Keep q0/j0 explicit in the common mean/background model, or specify a joint prior and its propagated covariance once. Do not both marginalize them and add the same uncertainty again.

concrete_decisions_before_total_covarian.decision: Reproduce or revise SBF-flow error prescription e(m110)-only; e(M110) is present and nonzero, so neither absorption nor independent addition may be asserted without a component statement.
MM numerical logH variance remains unevaluated until a specifically authorized error-only propagation can use D, or an already published relative-error input is pinned.
Preserve and qualify the SN 277-row covariance and compression normalization/support. Existing symmetric/finite/diagonal-positive diagnostics do not establish PSD/rank.
State finite cross-block independence or selected shared-systematic alternatives and whether input SN covariance already includes the velocity/intrinsic components being added.
Use common q0/j0/background conventions across means, fixed data set and mixed row units; do not promote a fixed-intercept compression beyond its model qualification.
